meta.notes: Automatically assembled controlled-pilot snapshot from the Morganton weather workflow. Defaults to REVIEWED and never self-designates OPERATIONAL. Daily Downburst Model supplies the reviewed Downburst Index/SPC handoff; NWS Digital Forecast/grid data supply wind, QPF, temperature, snow and ice; MORG ECONet supplies antecedent rainfall; Load Stress remains manual.

downburst_workflow.notes: Daily Downburst Model handoff from 11:00 AM Model Refresh; verdict=CONDITIONAL; index=29; confidence=Moderate. Tropical rain brings a limited opportunity for embedded convection, but persistent cold-air damming, a more favorable severe-weather environment south and east of Burke, and missing current 12Z HRRR diagnostics keep the downburst signal near the bottom of CONDITIONAL.

nws_nbm.notes: Schema source bucket retained for backward compatibility. Actual source is NWS Digital Forecast / NDFD and api.weather.gov grid data for Morganton. Source-aligned 24-hour QPF window 2026-10-10T11:00:00-04:00 through 2026-10-11T11:00:00-04:00, 24 consecutive NWS one-hour QPF slots, no minute-level prorating. Wind gust uses the maximum NWS grid windGust overlapping the same 24-hour window. Minimum temperature uses NWS hourly grid temperature through 72 hours. Snow and ice use NWS grid accumulation intervals conservatively; non-zero partial boundary intervals are unavailable rather than prorated.
